svg.title: evict-kvzip
svg.desc: Query-aware vs query-agnostic scoring on a toy 14-token context at a 50% budget. SnapKV votes with question 1 and drops the refund amount, so question 2 fails. KVzip scores each KV pair by how much the model needs it to repeat the whole context, so both questions still find their evidence. Reported: 3 to 4 times smaller KV, about 2 times faster decode, contexts up to 170K.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: sj = maxg ≤ G, i ∈ repeat a(g) i,j

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: keep = Topr% (s) pooled over all heads
Q2 How much is the refund?
reported: 3–4× smaller KV · ≈2× faster FlashAttention decode · contexts to 170K · LLaMA3.1, Qwen2.5, Gemma3
